Bhuvaatsing B. Jadhav Senior Business Analyst | Capital Markets & Regulatory Reporting

| +91 9021370652| +91 9 5 0 3 6 9 6 9 6 2 | Pune, India | Email Id: bhuvatmf@gmail.com

O B J E C T I V E

Senior Business Analyst with ~10 years of experience in Capital Markets, Regulatory Reporting and Investment Banking. Specialised in translating complex regulatory and business requirements into detailed BRDs and FSDs, driving UAT, and collaborating with development teams to deliver compliant reporting solutions. Experienced with Axiom Controller View regulatory reporting platform and transaction reporting frameworks.

C O R E S K I L L S

Business Analysis

BRD & FSD Authoring | Requirement Elicitation | Gap Analysis | Functional Specification | Use Case Development

Regulatory Reporting

Axiom Controller View | Transaction Reporting (MiFID II / EMIR) | Fund Service Reporting | Compliance & Audit

Capital Markets

Equity & Derivatives | Fixed Income | Fund Services | Investment Banking | SEBI / KYC Compliance

UAT & Quality

UAT Planning & Execution | Defect Lifecycle Management | Test Scenario Design | ISTQB Foundation

Tools & Technical

JIRA & Confluence | SQL (data analysis & workflow optimisation) | Agile / Scrum | CSM Certified

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

Senior Business Analyst Tata Consultancy Services

Jan 2023 – Present

▶ Client: Trafigura | Axiom Regulatory Reporting

Analysed and interpreted regulatory reporting requirements; translated them into detailed BRDs and FSDs for implementation on the Axiom Controller View platform.

Defined functional specifications for data cubes, workflows and reporting outputs; reviewed designs with development



teams to ensure business requirements were accurately reflected. Identified and documented data workflow gaps in collaboration with technical teams; optimised SQL-based reporting processes, reducing execution time by ~1 hour.

Conducted requirement walkthroughs and reviews with business stakeholders; managed scope changes and ensured traceability from requirements through to delivery.

Facilitated weekly business review calls, produced status reports and managed requirement-related escalations to resolution.

Defined and owned release documentation in JIRA; coordinated sign-off and ensured requirements were met prior to each release.

Analysed transaction reporting obligations and documented functional requirements to support compliance with regulatory reporting SLAs.

Conducted root cause analysis on reporting incidents; documented findings and worked with development teams to implement fixes.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify process improvement opportunities and documented revised workflows and business rules.

Acted as requirements point-of-contact for business stakeholders, clarifying scope and ensuring timely resolution of functional queries.

Business Analyst Infosys Technologies Ltd.

Jan 2020 – Dec 2022

▶ Client: Citi Group | Fund Service Reporting

Gathered and documented detailed business requirements for audit and transaction reporting solutions covering equity, fixed income, dividend and interest reports.

Authored functional specifications defining clear scope for report migration and enhancement; ensured requirements were aligned with business and compliance expectations.

Analysed existing reporting systems to identify gaps and improvement opportunities; documented findings to support migration planning.

Planned and executed UAT for daily asset summary and by-type reports; designed test scenarios, tracked defects and managed resolution through the full defect lifecycle.

Coordinated requirement dependencies across development, QA and business teams; proactively flagged and resolved ambiguities to avoid delivery delays.

Presented requirements and UAT outcomes to business stakeholders; secured sign-off by ensuring deliverables met functional expectations.

Operation Executive – Dealer (Equity & Derivatives) Stock Holding Corporation of India Ltd.

Sep 2016 – Dec 2019

Provided financial planning and investment advisory to HNI clients across equity and derivatives markets based on market research and risk profiling.

Ensured compliance with SEBI regulations, KYC guidelines and audit requirements; handled Demat account operations for domestic and NRI clients.

Managed DP operations including dematerialisation, transmission, DIS processing and account modifications.

E D U C A T I O N

M.Com | Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University

2020

B.Com | Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Marathwada University

2015

C E R T I F I C A T I O N S

Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) — Scrum Alliance • • NISM Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives • NISM Series-VII: Securities Operations & Risk Mgmt.

ISTQB Foundation Level

NISM Series-VI: Depository Operations • NISM Series-V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors • IRDA Composite Agent Certification
